title: Joint Consistency: A Unified Test-Time Aggregation Framework via Energy Minimization
abstract: arXiv:2605.06219v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies test-time aggregation, an approach that generates multiple reasoning traces and aggregates them into a final answer. Most existing methods rely on evaluation signals collected from candidate traces in isolation or answer frequencies, while ignoring comparative interactions among candidates. We propose Joint Consistency (JC), formulated as a constrained Ising-type energy minimization problem, which employs both independent evaluation signals and pairwise comparisons using LLM-as-a-judge. JC provides a unified framework for test-time aggregation that subsumes typical voting and weighted aggregation methods as special cases. Moreover, we develop an efficient approximation strategy that makes interaction modeling practical for large-scale test-time aggregation. Experiments on math and code reasoning benchmarks show that JC outperforms existing baselines across tasks, judge models, trace budgets, and trace-generation se

translated_title: 联合一致性：一种基于能量最小化的统一测试时聚合框架
translated_abstract: 本文研究了测试时聚合，这是一种生成多条推理轨迹并将其聚合为最终答案的方法。现有的大多数方法依赖于从孤立的候选轨迹中收集的评估信号或答案频率，而忽略了候选之间的比较性交互。我们提出了联合一致性（JC），将其表述为一个受约束的伊辛型能量最小化问题，该方法同时利用独立评估信号和基于LLM作为裁判的成对比较。JC为测试时聚合提供了一个统一框架，将典型的投票和加权聚合方法作为特例纳入其中。此外，我们开发了一种高效的近似策略，使得交互建模在大规模测试时聚合中切实可行。在数学和代码推理基准上的实验表明，JC在各种任务、裁判模型、轨迹预算和轨迹生成设置下均优于现有基线。
tldr: 提出联合一致性（JC）框架，将测试时聚合建模为受约束的伊辛型能量最小化问题，结合独立评估信号与LLM裁判的成对比较，统一了投票和加权聚合方法，并在数学和代码推理任务上优于现有基线。
en_tdlr: Joint Consistency (JC) formulates test-time aggregation as a constrained Ising-type energy minimization problem that leverages both independent evaluation signals and LLM-as-a-judge pairwise comparisons, unifying voting and weighted aggregation methods as special cases and outperforming existing baselines on math and code reasoning benchmarks.
